description: This file defines the ProgrammerCalculatorPage class, which provides UI automation objects and helper methods for interacting with a calculator application in Programmer Mode, including navigation, clearing display, and managing panels.

classes.name: ProgrammerCalculatorPage
classes.description: Represents the UI automation interface for the calculator in Programmer Mode, providing access to panels, navigation, and control methods.

methods.name: NavigateToProgrammerCalculator
methods.description: Switches the calculator to Programmer Mode using the navigation menu.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears the calculator display, memory, and optionally the history panel based on the current page source.
